notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jUniRZD.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] New environment - harvest field! 
[*] Fixed a major rendering bug that alternately caused the fire to render all white or not at all on some devices
[*] Added Mac and Linux support
[*] Tweaked the presets a bit
[*] Holding right click with the log tool now lets you rotate the log
[*] Improved the feeling of scaling logs and paper
[*] Adjusted the audio levels
[*] Happy Halloween!
[/list]
